tasks.title: Conversation #67
tasks.transcript:
Man: I'm so excited about our road trip this weekend. I'm all packed and got the food and snacks for the trip.
Woman: I thought David was supposed to prepare snacks.
Man: No, it was me. David signed up to bring water for everyone.
Woman: I see.
Man: Are you all packed?
Woman: Yes, I just want to get my car checked before we leave. I'm taking it to the mechanic tomorrow morning.
Man: Good idea. By the way, I just checked and there might be light showers in the afternoon, but overall good weather on our route.

questions.stem: What does David need to do for the road trip?
questions.analysis: 答案： A 题目问的是: David 需要为这次自驾游做什么？ 定位原文: Man: "No, it was me. David signed up to bring water for everyone." 选项分析: A. Bring water (带水) - 正确。男士明确指出 David 负责带水。 B. Check the weather (查看天气) - 错误。这是男士自己刚刚做过的事情（"I just checked..."）。 C. Prepare food and snacks (准备食物和零食) - 错误。男士澄清这是他自己负责的（"it was me"），而不是 David。 D. Drive the car (开车) - 错误。对话中未提及谁负责开车。

questions.stem: What does the woman still need to do?
questions.analysis: 答案： B 题目问的是: 女士还需要做什么？ 定位原文: Woman: "Yes, I just want to get my car checked before we leave. I'm taking it to the mechanic tomorrow morning." 选项分析: A. Talk to David (和 David 谈谈) - 错误。对话中未提及她需要联系 David。 B. Visit a mechanic (去见机械师/修车工) - 正确。女士明确说她明天早上要把车带给"mechanic"（修车工）检查。 C. Plan the route (规划路线) - 错误。对话未提及她需要规划路线。 D. Pack her bags (收拾行李) - 错误。当男士问她是否收拾好时，她回答 "Yes"，说明已经完成了。
